query: In `src/werkzeug/_reloader.py`, explain how `run_with_reloader` runs an application under the reloader: how the reloader implementation is chosen, how the process behaves differently when it is the reloaded child versus the original parent, how the application and the reloader loop run together, and how it exits on a termination signal and on Ctrl+C.

operations.name: A termination signal makes the process exit cleanly
operations.needed_for: how it exits on a termination signal

operations.name: The reloader implementation is looked up by the requested type
operations.needed_for: how the reloader implementation is chosen

operations.name: In the child the application runs in a daemon thread
operations.needed_for: how the application runs in the reloaded child

operations.name: The reloader update loop runs alongside the application thread
operations.needed_for: how the application and the reloader loop run together

operations.name: The original parent process restarts itself under the reloader and exits with its status
operations.needed_for: how it behaves as the original parent

dependencies.name: Child versus parent is decided from an environment variable
dependencies.needed_for: how the process behaves as the reloaded child versus the original parent

dependencies.name: The application thread is started only after the reloader context has been entered
dependencies.needed_for: how the application and the reloader loop run together

revisions.change: Removed the `ensure_echo_on()` dependency. The function only calls a helper whose behaviour (restoring terminal echo) is not visible in `run_with_reloader`, and the question does not ask about it. Three dependencies and five operations remain; every expression is otherwise unchanged and the witness window is still 18 lines.
